facts.fact: The state information systems agency ACSI lists SIFEC, an application for managing civil status events that follows a person from birth through marital life to death, with the Ministry of the Interior as client, as a prototype with status 'in development', year 2018; no deployment in any office is stated.
facts.system: Système Intégré des Faits d'Etat Civil (SIFEC)

systems.tiers: prototype, in development (2018); no tier stated
